verdict.rationale: Clara is a spend-management platform, so AI expense coding and auditing is an applicable axis, but the evidence pack shows no first-party receipt reading or OCR, no AI-suggested categories or memos, and no duplicate or fraud detection. Labels for GL codes are applied manually or through the API. "Automated expense reporting… compliance" and "Clara Intelligence" spend insights are vague, adjacent claims. The MCP server and API are building blocks an external agent could use to construct this, which does not count as the product's own capability.
